settings.label: Where do I see my gem balance?
settings.text: Sign in from the account link or from checkout. Your balance and available rewards show at the top of the page.

settings.label: Did my old points carry over?
settings.text: Yes. Points earned before the switch were converted to gems and appear after your first sign-in.

settings.label: Do gems stack with sale prices?
settings.text: Gems can be redeemed on any order, but limited sets and custom clips are excluded from reward discounts.
